title: A byte order mark in front of a comment line after a bare document
notes: A document prefix is an optional byte order mark followed by comment lines, so the mark in front of the comment is not part of the plain scalar `a`. The scalar cannot continue onto the line either: the mark is not a plain character (production 27).

provenance.reference: A reader that joined the byte order mark and the comment text to the preceding plain scalar, returning `a` followed by the mark and `# c`.
